name: Limit Order Hook
mechanic: Onchain limit orders: records the pre-swap tick and fills resting orders after.
plain: Enables limit-order functionality on a v4 pool. It records the tick before each swap and, after the swap, delegates to a LimitOrderManager that fills any resting orders the price crossed.
rules: Resting limit orders fill when a swap crosses their tick.
Order bookkeeping is delegated to a LimitOrderManager contract.
